direction: About 10 s. A low angle along the grass. A Gunter's chain lies taut between two iron arrows, and its brass tallies catch the light. Dai's boots plant a ranging pole at the hedge-bank. The camera tracks slowly along the chain. Ambience: chain links clinking, wind in the hedge. Caption only, no voice.

still.prompt: Photoreal 16:9 close low-angle shot in a Welsh field c. 1786. An iron surveyor's Gunter's chain is stretched taut across rough grass between iron marking arrows, with small brass tally tags on the links. A big man's worn leather buckled shoes and woollen stockings stand at the far end beside a red-and-white wooden ranging pole planted at a hawthorn hedge-bank. Overcast light, shallow depth of field. Period-accurate. No text, no heraldry.

captions.text: Estate plans of lands in Cogan, Llandough, Penarth, St Andrews Major and Sully, 1786–1832, survive in the Percy Randell collection (CH-0004). This survey day is recreated as the most likely moment.
